priorityList: Cast Reap with 3 stacks of Voidfall (Outside of Void Metamorphosis)
Cast Void Ray with 100 or more Fury (Aim to cast right before Void Metamorphosis to leverage the Fury refund)
Cast Voidblade before Collapsing Star or a Moment of Craving buffed Cull (During Void Metamorphosis)
Cast Collapsing Star when at 30 Souls (During Void Metamorphosis)
Cast Cull with 3 Voidfall stacks, or 4 Soul Fragments on the ground (Gather souls if it will not overcap Fury)
Cast Voidblade and Cast Consume before entering Void Metamorphosis
Cast as many Collapsing Star as possible in one Void Metamorphosis window
